annotations.title: Get the papers citing a paper

description: Lists the papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus that cite one paper, given by PubMed ID or DOI: the 500 most cited of them, the most similar to the paper first (by their stored embeddings). Returns each with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, citation count and similarity, and says how often the paper is cited in all. Citation links come from OpenAlex.

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

id.description: The cited paper: its PubMed ID (e.g. "21376230") or DOI (e.g. "10.1016/j.cell.2011.02.013").

offset.description: Skip this many papers to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 500 (optional)

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)
